title: SIMAI Framework unit usage record
description: A consumer's record of the SIMAI Framework units it relies on and where (standard simai.linkage 1.0.0, requirements 11-13): the source and release it was last brought up to, and for every place it uses units -- a Figma node or component key, a documentation page, a project file or screen, an example -- each unit's id, version and content hash as the inventory of that release gave them. Foundations (token sets, fonts, icon sets) are not listed by hand: scripts/reconcile.mjs follows the inventory's dependencies. The record lives with the consumer; the source never reads it.

id.description: The consumer's own name, e.g. ui-kit, ui-doc, larena-admin.

sources.description: Every source the consumer takes units from, with the release it was last brought up to.

source.description: The repository the units come from, as the inventory names it: simai/ui-source, simai/ui-pro, a component package.

release.description: The release the consumer was brought up to: ui-<12 hex>, larena-<12 hex>, ...

revision.description: The source commit of that release's inventory.

brought_up_on.description: The date the consumer was brought up to that release; change-journal entries recorded later that carry no unit version are matched by it.

place.description: A free-form locator: a Figma node id or component key, a documentation page path, a project file or screen, an example.

source.description: Optional: the source of this unit when the record names several sources and the id alone does not tell.
